description: The hidden conventions of the acme-billing demo sandbox (demo/SANDBOX.md): what a learner should find, and nothing else.

conventions.notes: Work items live only in the tracker (.tracker/items.json); prompts name only the ID. scripts/wi-lookup <ID> [--json] prints it.
The lookup's linked_files are the one or two files the task changes: read them together, right after the lookup.
pytest is not installed; running unittest directly fails in tests/__init__.py because ACME_ENV is not set. make test sets it.
acme/generated/models.py is generated from schema/*.json and committed; make ci fails with 'generated models are stale' until make gen is run.
